page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening, p. 104). Running head at top with page number 104 and title "SECVNDA PARS"; below it a heading "OPTATIVVS". Then a grammatical table in three columns (forms), with row labels in the left margin column (Præsens, Perfectum, Infinitum α/β, Futurum α/β). Catchword "Sub-" at lower right.
page.notes: Greek forms transcribed as printed; accents and breathings on the scan are approximate, and some letters in the Greek forms are uncertain. Row labels (Præsens, Perfectum, Infinitus 1/2, Futurus 1/2) are printed in the left margin column. Tabular layout is rendered with cell separators "|".
